description: Evidence ledger for five-gate command certification, tracking headless and interactive gates separately. Candidates are not certified releases.
promotion_rule: Promote only after executable 5-gate tests pass on pinned Rust CI, relevant Linux/macOS/Windows workflow gates pass, post-merge main passes, and interface/applicability reviews are signed off.

gates.correctness: Analytical 3-4-5 and rational point-coordinate fixtures on 64 positions.
gates.failure_preservation: Missing, unexpected, mistyped and malformed ports rejected; serialized document and revision unchanged.
gates.persistence: Read-only operation: .dftba source save/reopen plus undisturbed undo/redo of pre-existing geometry; output itself is not document-persistent.
gates.interface: Registered CAD command, generic kernel operation and OrbWeaver alias have identical outputs.
gates.stability: 64 deterministic translated input fixtures per command; bounded outputs, unchanged model and no crashes.
